text:
Maya (CEO): leaving a short follow-up for the wins/losses segment from today if you missed it, post Qs here
Liam (Head of Sales): quick field note: won one POC after offering scoped eval + SLAs, lost another where buyer picked a cheaper quantized self-hosted option
Elena (Customer Success): echo. customers who stayed said our eval help (scoring+sanitization) mattered more than raw perf numbers
Sam P. (VP Product): for the loss: did procurement mention which cost buckets mattered? infra cost or integration time?
Liam (Head of Sales): mainly infra cost and perceived ops headcount. they worried about ongoing spend vs a one-time infra lift
Rohit (Solutions Eng): operationally we can show a "cost vs latency" example config in demos. small teams like concrete numbers: e.g., throughput at X qps = $Y/day
Anya (PM): product action: propose two artifacts  a public "latency profile" explainer and a "starter dedicated" quickstart for small teams. both include tradeoffs and sample configs
Elena (Customer Success): also add an "eval checklist" for Sales (data prep, privacy redaction, suggested prompts). CS uses that in calls and it shortens eval time
Liam (Head of Sales): Sales asks we standardize a small paid eval add-on so pricing isn't ad-hoc. that closed multiple deals last quarter
LegalBot: flag: add-on needs scope and max hours. suggest a template: 12 eng hours, 2 calls, deliverable = evaluation report
Maya (CEO): agreed. Sam/Anya own the two artifacts; Legal to draft the add-on template. can we get a 1-slide summary for sales by Wed?
Sam P. (VP Product): yes. Ill draft the latency explainer and the slide. Anya will draft starter quickstart. ETA: drafts by Tue, final Wed AM
Anya (PM): capturing actions: (1) latency doc, (2) starter quickstart, (3) eval add-on template, (4) 1-slide for sales. will post owners and deadlines in follow-up thread
Maya (CEO): perfect. thanks everyone  tag Anya for follow-ups.
